baseline.help:
falcon_hybrid --security 100|128 [--batch 1..1024] [--seed U64] [--iterations N] [--warmup N] [--threads N]
Inputs: distinct fn-dsa 0.3.0 original Falcon-1024 keys and signatures; generation is outside prover timing. Defaults: batch 32, seed 42.
Environment defaults: BITZ_BENCH_LAMBDA, BITZ_FALCON_BATCH, BITZ_FALCON_SEED, BITZ_BENCH_REPS, RAYON_NUM_THREADS.

candidate.help:
falcon_hybrid --security 100|128 [--protocol native|shared-prime] [--batch 1..1024] [--seed U64] [--iterations N] [--warmup N] [--threads N]
Inputs: distinct fn-dsa 0.3.0 original Falcon-1024 keys and signatures; generation is outside prover timing. Defaults: protocol native, batch 32, seed 42.
Environment defaults: BITZ_BENCH_LAMBDA, BITZ_FALCON_BATCH, BITZ_FALCON_SEED, BITZ_BENCH_REPS, RAYON_NUM_THREADS.

timing: Existing harness total_prover_ms = fresh witness generation + source commitments + proof construction; verification separate; public input generation and one-time preparation excluded. No stage tracing.
rss: External macOS /usr/bin/time -l whole fresh-process maximum resident set size, bytes; includes warmup/setup/digest work. Harness /proc metric remains null.
